This model is a fine-tuned version of [HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct](https://huggingface.co/HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct) on the [QuyenAnhDE/Diseases_Symptoms](https://huggingface.co/datasets/QuyenAnhDE/Diseases_Symptoms) dataset.

serving.text_only_input_quote: question = "If you had a time machine, but could only go to the past or the future once and never return, which would you choose and why?"
serving.system_prompt: You are a helpful AI assistant named SmolLM, trained by Hugging Face
serving.notes: config.json is LlamaForCausalLM, bfloat16, max_position_embeddings 8192, no vision config. generation_config.json has token ids only. The example question is the stock TRL prompt, not a medical question. The chat template inserts the SmolLM system line when the first message is not a system message. adapter_config.json is LoRA r 16, alpha 32, dropout 0.05, targets q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, o_proj, base HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct, with no quantization fields. The repo also has model.safetensors (134,515,008 BF16 parameters) and a copy of the adapter under final_checkpoint/. Whether the full file is a merge is not stated. training_args.bin is a pickle; its numeric hyperparameters were not read. The Weights & Biases run URL returns a redirect and was not read. YAML says licence: license, which is a placeholder, not a license name. The dataset card lists fields Code, Name, Symptoms, and Treatments, each marked More Information Needed, and says 400 x 4. The viewer loads 400 rows. The dataset card does not state a language; the viewer rows are English disease names. No paper and no project GitHub repository name this checkpoint. The TRL link is the library.

discrepancies: The card sentence "This model was trained with SFT.", the dataset, and the parent match the inventory row. The card does not mention LoRA. adapter_config.json is LoRA rank 16 and alpha 32. Epochs, learning rate, and batch size are in training_args.bin and were not read. The YAML licence value is the placeholder word license.
